QF.id: VI Debt Instruments and Government Securities_17

question.text: As per RBI policy effective June 30, 2001, which entities are required to hold Commercial Paper only in dematerialised form?

answer.text: Banks, financial institutions, primary dealers, and satellite dealers

explanation.text: The Logic: As per the RBI Monetary and Credit Policy 2001-02, effective June 30, 2001, banks, financial institutions, primary dealers, and satellite dealers are permitted to make fresh investments and hold Commercial Paper only in dematerialised form. The Trap: The requirement does not stop at banks or only at primary dealers; it specifically covers banks, FIs, PDs, and SDs as listed in the source. It also does not extend to "all institutional investors" as a generic category unless separately sourced. Note: The exact entities covered by the dematerialised-only holding requirement for CPs are limited to the source-listed set: banks, financial institutions, primary dealers, and satellite dealers.
